Verdict

Failed on output geometry, in 4.1 of 20 minutes. Corners and content right; the candidate read output_aspect_w_over_h: 0.894 next to a4_aspect: 0.707 and signed off without asking.

  • Requirement capture: weak
  • Data literacy: weak
  • Decomposition: adequate

  • Correction quality: not exercised
  • Domain vocabulary: weak

  1. Fix the output size before the first run.
  2. Read every number in notes.json aloud before accepting.
  3. Check geometry, not just content: header band angle, output at expected size.
  4. Name the problem in the opening line: perspective, 4-point homography, document rectification.
